name: ReviewList
description: Responsive customer-review rail that reuses the ProductList section heading and composes ReviewCard children.

figma.notes: English Site Optimization 2026 Image Card. Desktop shows three cards at 1440px content width and four at 1920px, with additional reviews continuing in the horizontal rail.

title.description: Visible section heading and accessible label.

reviews.description: Ordered customer reviews rendered in the rail.

viewAllHref.description: Destination for the optional view-all link.

previousLabel.description: Accessible label for the previous rail action.

nextLabel.description: Accessible label for the next rail action.

dividerPosition.description: Places the desktop section boundary above, below, or removes it; ignored below 1024px.

dividerVariant.description: Gray renders the 1px structural separator; black renders the theme-aware 2px emphasis separator.

focus.note: Product review links and shared rail controls keep token-backed focus treatments.

radius.note: Review cards use the component radius, product footers use the tag radius, and product thumbnails use half the tag radius for the compact 2px treatment.

accessibility.ariaPattern: Labelled review rail with accessible rating images and native product links.
accessibility.structure: The shared SectionHeading labels the rail; each list item contains one ReviewCard article.
accessibility.interaction: Product footers are keyboard-reachable links when href is supplied, and rail controls respect reduced motion.
